dramatic_truth: The theatre asks Greg back as a substitute because he knows the room, not because travel has transformed him into a superior performer or manager.
performance: He requests a low chair and clear path, refuses unsafe carrying, updates cue/prop state, misses one cue because he watches the acting and owns the mistake immediately.
screenplay: Prompt-side substitute shift; changed entrances and props are reconciled; body accommodations remain ordinary; shared work replaces maximum independence; rehearsal becomes operationally coherent.
prose_comparison: The procedural theatre texture is a homecoming test: Greg applies newer state discipline inside an old environment without rewriting the environment around himself.

dramatic_truth: Hessa forces Greg to demonstrate the emergency external-magic event as behavior and evidence rather than narrate a theory about it.
performance: He shows what he actually did, separates interruption/deflection from a generalized spell and accepts that the useful category may be narrower than his imagination wants.
screenplay: Hessa's blunt summons; Greg reconstructs the field movement; controlled comparison strips away story memory; a cleaner operational question survives.
prose_comparison: The repetition of the slide event is analytical replay with changed epistemic purpose, not redundant recap.

dramatic_truth: Sori's archive packet lets Greg verify one old-market/artifact question with documentary evidence and demonstrates what long-distance relationship work can produce asynchronously.
performance: He reads the docket narrowly, resists turning one clean provenance record into universal trust and updates what questions he will ask future sellers.
screenplay: Oilcloth packet from Sori; archive evidence compared against prior assumptions; one provenance chain becomes clean enough; Greg changes future buying behavior rather than declaring solved history.
prose_comparison: The document-heavy structure pays off a relationship and an epistemic thread simultaneously.

dramatic_truth: Greg's intermediary skill becomes directly useful at home when the best move is connecting people and terms rather than buying or doing the work himself.
performance: He starts by not buying, identifies who actually owns expertise and need, structures the handoff and accepts a fee for creating a functioning middle rather than pretending it was charity.
screenplay: Potential purchase refused; two parties with complementary needs are identified; Greg brokers contact/terms; value moves because he organized the connection.
prose_comparison: This is the home-market proof of the intermediary lane developed on the road, not another transaction chapter.

dramatic_truth: A South Road job tests whether Greg can organize a multi-person operation without confusing current scope with permanent responsibility.
performance: He tracks current state, current owner and next bell, delegates by real domain and refuses to let the project expand merely because he can see adjacent problems.
screenplay: South Road notice becomes work; team and authority boundaries established; moving pieces are coordinated; Greg repeatedly narrows back to the job's actual next state.
prose_comparison: The managerial repetition is intentional scaffolding for a new behavior: bounded organization rather than total systems ownership.

dramatic_truth: Day two proves the South Road organization can survive boredom, which is stronger evidence than a dramatic first-day save.
performance: Greg lets owners make their own calls, carries state forward cleanly, fixes small coordination failures without inventing crises and ends the day with ordinary maintenance.
screenplay: Second-day work mostly repeats process under changed minor conditions; handoffs remain intact; boring successful operation becomes evidence that the system is not dependent on constant intervention.
prose_comparison: The chapter's sameness is the result being tested. Compressing it away would remove proof of repeatability.

dramatic_truth: Greg finally stops hiding from the Vale balance behind smaller operating numbers and turns clearing the old debt into an explicit near-term objective.
performance: He reconstructs the real remaining obligation, distinguishes actual debt from support/favors and decides to kill the balance without emptying his ability to work.
screenplay: Small-number avoidance named; Vale account audited; real payoff target becomes visible; Greg commits earnings toward closure while preserving operating capacity.
prose_comparison: The accounting repetition changes from survival tracking to deliberate closure of an old constraint and is a major progression beat.

dramatic_truth: Greg returns to acting with financial pressure present but no longer allowed to consume the scene or turn every paid performance into debt exposition.
performance: He does the theatrical job, accepts mistakes and comedy as performance facts, earns money and keeps the Vale target in the background where it belongs.
screenplay: Twenty-copper post-payment state; theatre performance; scene timing and actor interaction; earnings accrue without replacing the artistic task.
prose_comparison: The return to performance supplies tonal and identity contrast while the financial arc keeps moving underneath.

dramatic_truth: Hessa turns Greg's emergency-magic insight into timing work, making measurable interruption windows more important than dramatic force.
performance: He follows the requested timing protocol, resists optimizing beyond the test and accepts small repeatable changes as more valuable than a flashy unbounded success.
screenplay: Hessa note; controlled timing session; attempts compare when intervention begins and what minimum change matters; result narrows toward usable interruption behavior.
prose_comparison: The numbered/timed cadence is experimental structure and should not be rhythm-compressed into a vague training montage.

dramatic_truth: A South Road reference arrives before the next job, converting prior bounded coordination into portable credibility and stronger contracting access.
performance: Greg treats the reference as proof of exactly what it certifies, applies it to the next opportunity and keeps the earning ladder separate from competence claims it does not support.
screenplay: Reference received; prior job becomes institutional evidence; next contracting opportunity is evaluated under improved credibility; financial closure moves closer.
prose_comparison: The paperwork is the causal bridge from doing useful work to being trusted with better work.
